instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an indoor martial arts studio with a grey floor and white walls. On the left foreground, the girl in the white uniform with a red belt (R4) holds a wide horse stance with fists at her hips. In the center background, the boy in the white uniform with a striped white belt (R2) stands with feet apart. On the right foreground, the girl in the orange uniform with a blue belt (R3) stands with fists at her hips. The three children are in a triangle formation, looking forward with serious expressions under soft, diffused side lighting.
